outcome: SUPERSEDED BEFORE LAUNCH by its OWN launch-bound sweep. Never launched, never consumed, $0.

money.note: no pod existed at any point. The authorization was issued and never presented to a launcher, so the grant is retired unconsumed rather than spent.

why_superseded.summary: The launch-bound sweep did exactly the job it exists for and returned FAIL. This record is kept because a sweep catching a stale derived record before a launch is the mechanism working, not a mishap to erase.
why_superseded.cause: `logs/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/plans/d1_design.json` stopped regenerating byte-identically the moment the failed attempt's $0.2513 was booked, because the design document's `budget` section is DERIVED LIVE from scripts/consolidate/derive_budget.py. Its `provisional_shortfall_usd` moved from -10.1812 to -9.9299 -- exactly the $0.2513 -- and the narrative that restates it moved with it.
why_superseded.where_it_would_have_been_caught_otherwis: ON THE BILLING POD. These two tests live in the suite D1 declares as its pod test gate, so an unswept launch would have reached TESTS_OK on an L40S and failed there. This is the second time in one session that D1's declared pod suite was the thing that found the defect; the first time it was already on a pod.
why_superseded.why_converge_before_sweep_missed_it: `scripts/consolidate/converge_before_sweep.py` regenerates the skip-predicate audit, the per-experiment closure snapshots, the run and stage indexes, the readiness pointer, the navigation, the log inventory and the document links. `write_d1_design.py` is not in that list, so the one derived record whose generator reads the live budget was the one the convergence tool did not regenerate.

the_science_is_BIT-IDENTICAL.method: every top-level key of the regenerated document compared against the committed one as sorted JSON

design_hash.why_this_is_not_a_protocol_change: `write_d1_design.build()` computes design_hash as sha256 over EVERY non-underscore top-level key, including the live `budget` block, so the document's fingerprint moves whenever the project's balance does. It has taken ELEVEN distinct values in the four days the record has existed -- 5bf1e3cb, b7002bb3, 76bddeec, 6db01608, 2c54dcd1, aae83151, dfea8e1e, e3bdc783, 72faa307, 4da9af37, 3affe2c6 -- so regenerating it is this repository's routine practice rather than an exception. The frozen SCIENCE is asserted directly and separately by `assert_session_contract`: measurement_protocol_id, config_hash, suite_content_sha256, position_policy_hash, the distribution support at K=200, micro_batch_size and packing, beam width and warmup levels, the frozen operator set and both calibration profiles.
design_hash.who_pinned_the_old_value: no test, no config and no executable. Only run records, which are historical evidence and are NOT rewritten: runs 173304, 193733, 055409 and this one keep the value they were issued against.

recommendation_to_the_maintainer.defect: A FROZEN SCIENTIFIC PLAN IDENTITY SHOULD NOT BE A FUNCTION OF THE PROJECT'S WALLET.
recommendation_to_the_maintainer.detail: Because `budget` is inside design_hash's preimage, every dollar spent anywhere in the project -- including an unrelated C1 engineering pod -- invalidates D1's committed design record, turns two tests in D1's declared pod gate red, and so blocks every D1 launch until the record is regenerated and the authorization re-issued against a new design hash. This round paid one full re-issue cycle for it, and the preregistered D1 screening and confirmation rungs will each pay it again.
recommendation_to_the_maintainer.minimal_fix: narrow the hashed preimage to the design's frozen terms -- keep the cost model, the accepted 1125.55-minute bound and the derived ceiling inside the identity, and exclude the live balance, which is a property of the ledger and not of the design.
recommendation_to_the_maintainer.why_it_was_not_done_here: it changes how a frozen identity is computed, which is a maintainer's call rather than something to slip in beside a launch. Regenerating the record is the established practice and is sufficient to launch; this is recorded as the root cause so the next rung does not rediscover it.

retry_policy.why: nothing was launched, measured or spent. Under AGENTS.md P12.1 this is ordinary engineering inside the already-approved phase envelope: no budget is widened and no frozen science is altered.
retry_policy.frozen_science_unchanged: K=200, bsz=3, length_sorted_v1, beam width 6 with one warmup level, the four frozen operators, both calibration profiles, the supervised_target arm, Top-2, the same accepted 1125.55-minute bound at the same live $1.09/h.
successor_requires: a new authorized base commit carrying the regenerated design
a new run id and a new one-use authorization binding the new design hash
a new canonical bundle derived from the new session commit
a fresh run-owned launch_bound sweep against that exact session tree

what_is_preserved.governance/authorization.json: the issued one-use artifact, unmodified. Retired unconsumed. It binds design hash 3affe2c65c57 and config 8e2d4dccac0032ef, which are what it was issued against.
what_is_preserved.governance/readiness.json: the FAIL sweep record, unmodified. It is the evidence that the launch-bound sweep refused this tree, and it names the two failing node ids and the commit it swept.
